events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Darien
events.description: 3 deaths. Walworth County. Widespread straight-line wind damage occurred from just south of Darien in the Sharon Township through Delavan Lake to Como. These strong winds also swept across Geneva Lake where a 25 foot boat with 10 people on board capsized and sank when high waves impacted the boat. 3 children drowned. Witnesses stated the high winds during the storm came in three distinct bursts. Several other boats also capsized on the lake. 5-10 barns were destroyed or heavily damaged and about 40 homes sustained some damage mostly from fallen trees. Three 20 foot by 90 foot empty silos collapsed and fell on 4…

events.title: Lightning near Waukesha Co Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Waukesha County. Report of a lightning-related fatality in a gas station parking lot.

events.title: Lightning near Michaels
events.description: 1 death. Washington County. An employee of the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources was struck by lightning when working outside near the New Fane hiking trail. The lightning strike was fatal.

events.title: Flood near Kirchhayn
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Washington County. A continuation of flooding of streets, creeks, rivers, low lying neighborhoods, and basements in Germantown and surrounding communities. Additional showers and storms aggravated the flooding. Some vehicles stranded in relatively deep, still water. More specifically, the flooding of the Menomonee River and its tributaries flooded and closed portions of many roads. This included portions of County Line Road, the northbound lane of I-41, Freistadt Road, Lilac Lane, Maple Road, Rockfield Road, and Wausaukee Road. The Riversbend Circle neighborhood in southwest Germantown experienced widespread…

events.title: Flash Flood near Carrollville
events.description: 1 death. Milwaukee County. Widespread and numerous reports of flash flooding in streets, in addition to rivers, creeks, and streams across the southern two thirds of Milwaukee County. 1800 homes were classified as major damage or destroyed due to flash flooding of the Lincoln and Honey Creeks. Many instances of flooded basements across the impacted area. Six foundations collapsed into basements of homes in the 60th street neighborhood near Lincoln Creek, with two homes being condemned. Additional basement collapse reported in West Allis near Honey Creek. Many vehicles stranded in flood waters, with multiple water…

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Cormier
events.description: 1 death. Brown County. Thunderstorm winds downed a tree onto a 9-year-old child on the west side of Green Bay. The person was taken to the hospital and passed away from the injuries. The time of this report is an estimate based on radar data.

events.title: Flood near West Allis
events.description: 3 deaths. Milwaukee County. A 10 year old boy fell into rapidly rising waters of a concrete drainage ditch after a thunderstorm with heavy rainfall. His father and neighbor jumped in to help, but all three were swept away and drowned. The boy was found downstream the next day in the Kinnickinnic River. The other two men were found June 16th in the same river.

events.title: Lightning near Menomonie
events.description: 1 death. Dunn County. Lightning struck two construction workers. One died and the other was transported to a local hospital with serious injuries.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ripon
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Fond Du Lac County. Multiple reports of trees down, snapped power poles, road closures, and power outages in the Ripon area. Sheet metal roofing or siding was strewn in the field on either side of Brandon Street, north of the intersection with Highway KK. Damage was assessed to be due to straight-line winds. A man was killed when he drove his car into a downed tree on a road near Ripon.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Liberty
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Vernon County. One person was killed in a single vehicle accident east of Liberty. The accident occurred during a thunderstorm with heavy rain. The driver was believed to have lost control in the heavy rain with the vehicle leaving the road, rolling and ejecting the driver.

events.title: Flash Flood near Deer Park
events.description: 1 death. St. Croix County. Parts of St. Croix County received over 8 to 9 inches of rain causing flooding and washed out roads across the county. The worst areas that experienced significant flooding were the Kinnickinnic, Rush and Eau Galle Recreation River areas, and the towns of Hammond, Baldwin, Emerald, Glenwood City, and Cylon. ||Some of the specific roads that were closed or washed out during the height of the flooding were: 1000 Block of 190th Street in Baldwin, 2100 110th Avenue in Baldwin, Country Road TK, DD & 240th Street in Baldwin, Highway 12 & 220th Street in Baldwin Township, 2254 130th Avenue in…

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Lake Butte Des Morts
events.description: 1 death. Winnebago County. Thunderstorm winds capsized a boat on Lake Butte des Morts. Two people and a dog were in the boat. One person and the dog survived. A 61 year old male was found dead along the shoreline the next day.

events.title: Flood near Lake Church
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Ozaukee County. Numerous flooding reports all over the county with some road closures. Numerous basements flooded in Port Washington. A retaining wall collapsed onto an elderly woman in Port Washington, killing her. Two drivers rescued driving into deep water underneath a railroad bridge on Spring St. and Sunset Rd. in Port Washington.

events.title: Flood near Keshena
events.description: 1 death. Menominee (c) County. Fast flows and flooding on the Wolf River caused a fatality as someone drowned from the abnormally fast current. The victim went into the river in Keshena that is frequently used for swimming.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Whitehall
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Trempealeau County. A fatal accident occurred during a thunderstorm with heavy rain south of Whitehall. Authorities believe weather was a factor in the head-on two vehicle crash. One person was killed with the other driver sustaining serious injuries.

events.title: Flood near Marinette
events.description: 1 death. Marinette County. Runoff from rainfall and snow melt led to minor flooding and rapid flows on the Menominee River near and downstream from McAllister. Shortly before the flooding subsided, a fishing boat capsized in Marinette causing two men to fall into the river. One was rescued shortly thereafter and was treated and released from the hospital. The other drowned and his body was discovered two days later near Oconto in the waters of Green Bay, more than 15 miles from Marinette.

events.title: Flood near Victory
events.description: 1 death. Vernon County. An elderly woman drowned in Mississippi River flood waters in the vicinity of Blackhawk Park. Sometime during the night of March 29th into the early morning hours of March 30th, the woman wandered away from her home and was swept away by flood waters.

events.title: Flash Flood near Springfield Corners
events.description: 1 death. Dane County. The widespread flash flooding of creeks and streets in Middleton, Verona, and the west side of Madison resulted in dozens of flooded or stranded vehicles, over 50 water rescues, and hundreds of citizens stranded in place. One drowning death occurred when a man attempted to escape the flood waters by exiting his vehicle. Many city streets were closed including major thoroughfares. 70 residences in the village of Shorewood Hills suffered water damage with 15 families displaced from their homes. Basement flooding was common in Madison and suburbs to the west and south. Water rescues were also…

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Edgewater
events.description: 1 death. Sawyer County. Strong thunderstorm winds blew over an oak tree onto an occupied camper, killing one of the occupants and injuring 3 others. Numerous trees were blown over roadways in the area as well.

events.title: Flash Flood near Sandborn
events.description: 1 death. Ashland County. A truck went into a ditch on County Truck E just south of County Trunk C in the Township of White River. The roadway was completely underwater and the water in the ditch was 6 to 8 feet in depth. The truck was found unoccupied with the driver side door open. The 75 year old male driver was found deceased 60 feet from the vehicle.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Chetek
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Barron County. The Chetek Police Department confirmed a storm-related fatality, as a 46-year-old was killed while cutting down storm damage and the debris rolled over the individual. This was an indirect fatality.

events.title: Flood near De Soto
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Crawford County. One person drowned when he unknowingly drove his vehicle into a section of washed out road south of De Soto. Persistent high flows along the Mississippi River caused a portion of State Highway 82 to wash out.

events.title: Tornado near Reeve
events.description: 1 death. Barron County. The tornado first developed over southeastern Polk County, then tracked mostly east-northeast across southern Barron before moving into Rusk County and eventually Price County. In Barron County, the tornado hit numerous farmsteads, devastating barns and other outbuildings. The hardest hit area in Barron County was just north of Chetek, WI, where high-end EF2 damage was found. A number of mobile homes were completely demolished, and this is where the one fatality occurred. After that, several turkey barns were leveled, and then multiple homes were hit hard near Prairie Lake, especially those…

events.title: Flash Flood near Viroqua Muni Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Vernon County. Heavy rain caused flash flooding to occur across much of Vernon County. One person was killed near Victory when a mudslide caused a home to slide down a hillside very early in the morning of the 22nd. Numerous other houses were damaged by rocks, debris and floodwaters in Victory when a culvert used to divert water around town became blocked. In and around De Soto, two people had to be rescued from flood waters and 15 people were evacuated from a trailer park. The flood waters also covered State Highway 35. Flooding along Coe Hollow Creek prompted officials to evacuate Sidie Hollow Park but…

events.title: Flood near Viroqua Muni Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Vernon County. One man drowned in southern Vernon County when he attempted to drive his pickup across a flooded road. The pickup and cattle trailer he was pulling got stuck in the flood waters with the water eventually filling the passenger compartment of the truck.

events.title: Lightning near Minocqua
events.description: 1 death. Oneida County. A 66-year-old man was struck by lightning outside his residence on Tanglewood Court in Minocqua. He was first taken to Howard Young Medical Center, then transported to St. Claire's Hospital in Weston. From there, he was taken to a burn center in Madison where he died from his injuries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Grandview
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Bayfield County

events.title: Flood near Marengo
events.description: 1 death. Ashland County. An 82-year-old man from Marengo was found dead in his pickup truck in the flooded waters along the Marengo River near the Riemer Road Bridge west of Marengo. The exact circumstances of how, when, and where he died are not known, only that he was found a few days after the heavy rains some time early Thursday.

events.title: Flood near Cable Union Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Bayfield County. An 84-year-old Illinois man died when his car became partially submerged into floodwaters along a ditch along County Highway M, about 3 miles east of Cable. The man and his 84-year-old wife were attempting to turn around after encountering a washed out section of the Highway near the Namekagon River, but accidentally backed up into the flooded ditch. The man drowned, but a firefighter saved the wife.

events.title: Flash Flood near Cedar
events.description: 1 death. Iron County. Flash flooding along the Oronto and Parker Creeks damaged the infrastructure of Saxon Harbor and parts of the Saxon Harbor Campground. One man died from the flooding.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Iduna
events.description: 3 deaths (indirect). Trempealeau County. Three people were killed in a two car crash that occurred in heavy rain from a thunderstorm. Two other people suffered injuries in the crash. The accident occurred on State Highway 95 east of Arcadia.

events.title: Lightning near Morgan
events.description: 2 deaths. Oconto County. Lightning from a thunderstorm that quickly developed west of Abrams killed two men working on a tree house at a home on County Road E in the Town of Morgan. The men were struck by lightning from the storm as it passed about two miles to their south. One of the men, a 27-year-old, was killed instantly. The other, a 31-year-old, was taken to a Green Bay hospital and died of his injuries on August 6th.

events.title: Lightning near Downtown Janesville
events.description: 1 death. Rock County. A man was struck by lightning and killed when he got out of his vehicle on highway 14 to correct the windshield wiper. A line of severe thunderstorms was moving through the area at the time.

events.title: Lightning near Vaudreuil
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Jackson County. An elderly lady died from smoke inhalation after a lightning strike started her house on fire in Black River Falls. At least three other nearby homes also suffered some electrical damage.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Devils Lake State Park
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Sauk County. A large oak tree uprooted and landed on a tent killing a 10 year old girl and injuring her father and brother. The tree fell approximately 1 hour after thunderstorms with heavy rains. Nearby observations and Doppler radar suggest around 1.90 inches of rain fell. The roots of the tree grew over a large rock and the soil was saturated from the heavy rain. These factors may have weakened the stability of the tree and it fell.
